name: razor-source-map-untested-directly
body: MapSpan has no direct C# harness test; only the razor_engine_single_file_smoke e2e exercises it end to end through the --razor mode, using each method's Identifier span. A span under `#line hidden` maps to null. Upgrade: add a harness test when a later task opens src/csharplib/tests/Program.cs for Razor (phase 7).
